preview_snapshot times out or returns a stale image when the desktop window is minimized, hidden, covered, or on another macOS Space, because the occluded guest does not present a fresh frame. Agents see this as a page-capture failure. Take it at chronological intake; the fork's capture retry and timeout handling in apps/desktop/src/preview/Manager.ts must be reconciled with its Page.captureScreenshot path.

Imported provisionally as one snapshot: a cached styal Link websocket-ticket request that times out is retried once with the same token (3 s, then 7 s), the token is kept on a second timeout, and only the third timeout in a row asks the relay for a new credential. The fork applied it on top of the learned LAN and tailnet routes the PR predates: the retry also targets a direct endpoint, and a direct route still fails that route and keeps its token before the timeout count applies. One supervisor test waits 2 s for its first backoff to match the jittered retry schedule. When it merges, compare the frozen base-to-head diff with the final upstream change, reconcile how upstream combined it with #19426's 6 s ticket timeout, rerun the relay ticket supervisor and authorization tests, then clear the snapshot marker with that intake. If it closes without merging, review whether to remove the change or retain it as maintained fork behavior and record that decision before clearing the marker.

Refreshes provider discovery after CLI updates and allows a freshly probed signed-out installation to verify successfully. Needed before separating managed provider updates from authentication. Take at chronological intake; reconcile styal's additional blanket health-error check and preserve genuine executable/probe failure detection, since cached auth and version can outlive a failed health check.

Moves agent preview tabs from the desktop app to a browser on the environment server. The fork imported #17693 early while previews still ran in the desktop app, so it kept the desktop wording of the no-host and recording-transfer errors and the MCP snapshot test that checks it. #15328 does not change those messages and the queue already counts #17693 as recorded, so when the queue reaches #15328, also apply #17693's wording for them. Its server snapshot captures desktop tabs with Page.captureScreenshot through the CDP relay. That works upstream, where the webview keeps its full layout size under a CSS transform, but the fork fits previews with device-metrics emulation, so the guest surface is only the panel size and Chromium tiles it into the screenshot. Keep fitted desktop captures on the full-surface capturePage path (ledger preview-surface-continuity) rather than taking the relayed screenshot. The fork also took its broker change early, without provenance: a timed-out background status read (the 500 ms tool-icon lookup) no longer disconnects the preview host. Take upstream's broker code and test over the fork's copy.

If it reopens and merges, compare the frozen base-to-head diff with the final upstream change, reconcile amendments and the held-key handling, verify Undo from the composer, text undo after typing and a held key, then clear the snapshot marker with that intake.

Replaces the resume compaction banner with compact-on-send, which #17127 turns into a Compact chip. Upstream offers it whenever the selected provider is Claude, so an idle thread switched from Codex to Claude offers to compact the Codex session's usage, although Orchestrator V2 hands Claude a bounded summary instead of resending that history. Fork #819 gates the banner on resumesClaudeSession (the next turn resumes the same native Claude session). When intake reaches #16631 and #17127, keep that check on the compact-on-send and chip path, verify a Codex to Claude switch shows no offer while a stale Claude thread still does, and remove this entry.

Depends on #17585.

This PR reads result.permission_denials and filters out denials styal already handled. Do not import it early: its migration 065 collides with upstream's 065 to 067, which the fork does not have yet. When it lands through intake, count its filtered denials into autoReviewsDenied on Claude Auto turns, add Claude's denial rate to the PostHog Auto alert, and update the provider-auto-default ledger entry.

Fixes the confirmed Claude continuation stall where a queued user prompt answers an already-open native wake, leaving its continuation waiting for a consumed result. The fork provider-stall detector records and warns about these incidents independently; this tracking entry does not import or duplicate the upstream fix.

If it merges, take it at chronological intake after #23063 and #23467, then add a fork commit that lets styal.json declare prompt actions (type and prompt, no modelSelection, no setup or settle roles, no approval for a manual run) and update the styal-project-file ledger entry and docs. Rewrites t3_thread_launch so scratch reads as the choice for callers outside a thread, dropping the fork's "outside any repository" pitch. Take it at chronological intake; if agents still launch from a project thread into No project afterwards, tighten the scratch wording in a fork commit.
